title: Trust Recovery
concept: Proof Protocol applied to breaches: name breach, define change, window, track facts, review.
whenToUse: After betrayal, deception, repeated broken agreements, or any before/after in safety.
steps: Name the breach clearly, without deflection.
Define one specific observable behaviour change.
Set a meaningful window with review dates.
Review: record first, then feelings; extend/adjust/close.
[WARN] If safety absent, stop and seek appropriate support.

phrases.text: The breach was ___. I’m not debating that.
My proof behaviour is ___. You’ll see it when ___.

working: Breach named. Proof: proactive updates if late + calendar transparency. 4 weekly reviews. Partial week owned. Nervous system quieter; window extended.
notWorking: Apology speeches without behaviour — or forcing “trust me again” before evidence — or tracking as humiliation.
activity: Complete one Proof row + 4-week table together. Pair with Proof Protocol card.
warn: If safety absent, stop and seek appropriate support.
